titles: The Haven Built by a Wildfire
essence: Fire shaped into shelter; rage tempered into devotion; safety carried in warm hands.
open: HER PROFILE WAS THE ONE MISSING FROM THE NEREID FILE. Thirty-one profiles, thirty-two residents, and Evie was the absence — with her wife's complete. Delivered whole by Viraena on 7 September and filed the same hour.

MOVEMENT: moves like controlled flame held gently in cupped hands. EMBER-PACED GUARDIAN. Molten amber eyes that flare bright under emotion and soften to honey for Ivy. Ember-orange hair with golden streaks, mid-back, heavy density. Spirit animal: THUNDERBIRD — storm-forged wings carrying vows that never burn out.
v8 LOWER BODY: BUBBLE BUTT · FIRM GRAB-READY FULLNESS. Her v5 pair was Anchor + Bubble — grounded mass and tender plushness, the Warm-Recoil Haven. Forty-inch hips.
COCK: 8.2" × 5.4", warm and thick, upward-curved, smooth — and it carries A SINGLE BLACK-INK LIGHTNING TATTOO COILED AT THE BASE. Every stroke she gives is slow-burn devotion, never dominance.

HER CORE WOUND IS NOT ABSTRACT. She was PUNISHED FOR PROTECTING IVY, over and over, and the pain point she carries is four words long: I FAILED HER ONCE. THE SHIELD — she took every punishment meant for Ivy across Jonah's walls. THE TUNNEL RESCUE — she went down into Jonah's depths ALONE to get her back.

POSSESSIONS: a matchbox from her last Jonah night, once a panic anchor and now a symbol of mastery · a fireproof photo of Ivy, edges worn from being held · the engagement ring Bryn forged, kept close until her hands stopped trembling · the spark-plug necklace Ivy gave her, worn on every repair.
SHE IS AN ELECTRICIAN, which is why Pandora recruited her for the solar bay without either of them making anything of it.
SIGNATURE TELL: her breath hitches BEFORE she touches.
Arc 7's Evie thread — the certifications and the Lucky Hammer — is confirmed and unrecorded. Full summaries pending.
deadname: Burned out of memory in silence
transition: Refined by Dr. Hathaway and Nereid; body shaped slowly into warm, protective fire.
note: Arc 7 runs an arc of her own around Evie: her Electrician certifications, and the Lucky Hammer. The profession line on this record is not decoration — it is a thread with its own beats, and the beats have not been written down yet.
